It comes with 0% commission, no account minimum, access to market data, easy account setup, and funding processes. Users can also get access to the latest news, market data, and other educational tools. Seif Amr established the company in 2020 in Cairo, Al Qahirah, Egypt.

about_short_description.short_description: Thndr is a financial services company that operates an app-based investment platform.

product.name: Thndr Investment Platform
product.description: A mobile and web-based investment platform for opening an account, funding a wallet, monitoring investments, and trading securities and investment funds.

product.name: Egyptian Securities Brokerage
product.description: A digital brokerage service that enables retail investors to buy and sell shares listed on the Egyptian Exchange through the Thndr platform.

product.name: U.S. Securities Trading
product.description: A digital trading service that gives Thndr users access to U.S. financial securities through the platform and its brokerage partner.

product.name: Mutual Funds
product.description: An investment-fund marketplace offering equity funds and fixed-income or savings funds managed by professional asset managers.

product.name: Gold Investment
product.description: A digital gold-investment service that provides exposure to 24-karat gold through the AZG mutual fund.

product.name: UAE and ADX Trading Access
product.description: A digital brokerage service enabling eligible users to trade securities listed on Abu Dhabi Securities Exchange through Thndr.
